_readme: Simulation settings for ASTRA-66 (non-propulsion). Every value is validated by simulation/config.py.
launch_site values are USER planning defaults: replace them with the range's elevation and expected temperature.
rail.length_m = null uses RAIL_L from analysis/analysis.py (USER planning value).
aerodynamics values are ASSUMPTIONS of the drag build-up (see simulation/aerodynamics.py).
